definitions.explanation: The act of paying money that is owed.

notes:
{支払|しはらい} is the noun form meaning "payment," derived from the verb ⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧ (to pay).

- {支払|しはらい}⟦をする→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make a payment)
- {支払|しはらい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧ (payment is completed)
- {支払|しはらい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧ (payment is delayed)
